title: bn254-pairing-inversion: (6,2) STNFS behind a run gate, log phase at 1 x its expected work: 2^93.240943884

claims.statement: For the full-production bn254-pairing-inversion target, the algorithm of proof.md (with field-map.md, DESCENT.md, KERNELS.md, STORAGE.md) returns (P0,[x]Q0) with e(P0,[x]Q0)=z with success at least 0.39 over uniform challenges and fresh coins, and expected total classical work E[W] <= 1+(K/2^64)2^94.596341877 < 2^93.240943884 units (C=20,000 scalar AArch64 instruction equivalents), under heuristics H1-H4, H-EA, H-FFT, H-R, H-X, H-SEP and H5 (proof.md section 9). Before any other work one fresh 64-bit coin u is read and the run is opened only when u < K, K = 7209485459980042902, the least integer with (K/2^64) x 0.997884 >= 0.39; a closed run is a failure charged 1 unit. In an opened run both individual logarithms run under one combined phase meter of 2^110 units that aborts as failure; the ledger charges that phase at its expected work, at most 2^94.412562 units by the descent recurrence (H5), because the work before an abort never exceeds the uncapped work; the same recurrence gives the meter loss through Markov, P(cap) <= 0.000021, and the modeled opened-run success 0.997884 that the gate uses. No slack is claimed on H5. All preprocessing, failed trials, aborts, verification and output are charged once for this target; nothing is amortized over other targets.

experiments.purpose: Recompute the field, collection, filtering and cost-ledger arithmetic, including revised PGF-envelope descent and finite ECM-separation assumptions; the ledger part also recomputes the stressed success and the run-gate constant K; rebuild returns rounded draft declarations. Arithmetic passes do not establish production hypotheses. part=pgf recomputes alpha=.5 PGF envelopes at psi=0..0.8 step .01 on all862 downward-rounded raw-mu toy observations; part=porttoy redoes an exact whole ball or parent/child/control from fixed seeds. These are scoped toy checks, not production proofs. Default{} also replays all862 PGF observations. part=bw config0..3 replays seven-pad positive/negative diagnostics; part=adaptive_stats recomputes all171entered-node PGF strata; part=adaptive,side,root_seed,order regenerates bounded recursive whole-ball evidence. These do not establish production relation saturation or uniform conditional transfer. Default also replays all171adaptive observations with downward-rounded rawmu; censored root outcomes remain unknown. part=threshold verifies the judge counterexample and existing171 count tails for the corrected analytic inequality; it adds no empirical joint-law claim.
